choices.name: Genesis Essence
effects: Your equipped weapons are treated as tier 120.

assumptions: Each equipped weapon profile is raised to at least tier 120 once at the loadout-to-engine boundary before the existing accuracy and ability-damage formulas.
Main-hand, off-hand, defender half-tier, two-handed, Necromancy conduit, level/spell/ammunition caps, style, speed, passives, special attacks, ammunition, and weapon identity stay unchanged.
Shields are not weapons; their armour and off-hand classification stay unchanged.

choices.name: Power Archive
effects: Grants the Automaton Control Bot which stores up to 20 weapon or armour gizmos, granting their effects while wearing augmented equipment.
Combat perks in stored gizmos have their rank doubled, excluding perks that do not benefit from additional ranks.

assumptions: Displayed in Builds only; gameplay effects intentionally unwired.

choices.name: Chaotic Insight
effects: Each combat equipment item counts as 2 additional pieces towards its set effect.

assumptions: Displayed in Builds only; gameplay effects intentionally unwired.

reason: Route Genesis Essence through the shared effective weapon-tier input used by accuracy and ability damage; retain the other God Tier Two cards as displayed-only.
